name: LIMULUS CYCLOPS
key_symptoms: Mental depression. Difficult to remember names, confused with heat of face, rush of blood to face, worse when meditating. Pain behind left eye-ball.
Husky voice. Dyspnśa after drinking water. Oppression of chest.
Crural neuralgia. Soles of feet ache, feel numb. Pain in right hip-joint. Heels sore.
